en.app.title: Code Regulation Scanner
en.side.foot: Your code never leaves this machine
en.lang.label: Language
en.ready.sub: No cloud, no telemetry. Your source code never leaves the laptop.
en.install.canceledMsg: Stopped at {mb}. Whole files already fetched are kept.

Cancel this download?

Files that already finished stay on disk, so starting again only fetches what is still missing. The file in flight has to be downloaded again.

en.jur.eu.name: European Union
en.jur.eu.blurb: Six detector packs covering eight regulations, all local.

en.pk.gdpr.covers: Personal data: collection, retention, consent, subject rights, security.
en.pk.dora.covers: ICT risk, resilience testing and incident reporting for financial entities.
en.pk.dsa.covers: Content moderation, notice-and-action, recommender transparency, minors.
en.pk.eu_data_act.covers: Access to connected-product data, switching, cloud portability.
en.pk.cra_dma_nis2.covers: Product cybersecurity, gatekeeper duties, network and information security.

fr.app.title: Scanner de conformité du code

Les fichiers déjà terminés restent sur le disque : une nouvelle tentative ne récupère que ce qui manque. Le fichier en cours devra être téléchargé à nouveau.

fr.pk.dora.covers: Risque informatique, tests de résilience et notification d'incidents pour les entités financières.
fr.pk.dsa.covers: Modération des contenus, notification et action, transparence des recommandations, mineurs.
